executive_summary: Updated specifications for the 'criminology-cards-folder-redesign' change. Reverted REQ-SL-013 to use a 3-column vertical grid layout on desktop, collapsing to a single-column list on mobile, and asserting no cover image or description text. Updated ForensicFolderCard specs to enforce a vertical folder layout (flex-direction: column) with a header at the top (with a stickyNote) and a folderPaper insert below it (with Satisfy title, playback controls, and bottom action bar). Removed the polaroid cover image requirement.
